change: Compiler-only completed-producer proof binds exact checked key+1 consumers. The emitter substitutes wrapping addition only where successful producer completion has already excluded overflow. No array bound, portable selector, cursor or post-ID check is removed; no runtime cache or host kernel is added.

selection.reason: The first paired cohort is uncertain, and confirmation regresses against selected IR308. The same-runtime ablation does not establish a latency gain. Preserve the proof as unselected research and do not rerun unchanged.

fresh_profile.interpretation: Index work falls, but query work rises enough to outweigh it. Diagnostic elapsed times are not authoritative latency evidence.

native_code_inspection.limitation: Static stack references and frame size do not measure dynamic spill cost or establish cache pressure.

next_experiment: Keep the checked arithmetic and CFG through early cleanup/capture selection. Supply the compiler-certified upper bound to the existing later unsigned-guard pass, then inspect whether query code remains unchanged while surviving index checks disappear.
